Square canvas, icon centered in the middle 64% leaving equal 18% transparent padding. Genuine transparent background, no tile or enclosing circle. Palette: royal blue #2265F5, mint #12BE9A, orange #FF9A38, coral #FF7869, purple #8B72ED; pale tints for secondary shapes. Use only subject-specified colors, 2-4 colors total. NO gradients, shadows, lighting, texture, bevels, perspective, rendered 3D, black outline, branding or watermarks. No lettering unless the subject explicitly requires it. Keep sparse details and consistent visual weight. Subject: A blue landscape photo card with pale-blue mountain and warm yellow sun, small mint plus badge at lower right.
